text_block_list.text:
Called by King Halo, I arrived at the 
dance studio.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Today, I shall grant you the privilege of 
watching the King's dance lesson.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'll let you behold my first-rate dancing 
up close, so you better be grateful!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: One, two, three♪ One, two, three♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Now, it's time for the King Call! And 
a-one, two, three!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Don't just "Huh...?!" Do the call! The 
call!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Hype up the crowd along with yourself 
during the concert —that is the duty of a 
true professional."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just practice, I want to stay 
mindful of the actual live performance!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, all that hard practice would go 
to waste, wouldn't it?
choice_data_list: That's true, but it looks tough...!
That's true, but that sounds tough...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Well, asking you to recreate the live 
concert's atmosphere all by yourself is 
unreasonable, I admit."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Should we invite the younger girls too and 
really liven things up?
choice_data_list:
In that case, this should be training just 
like the real deal!

It's okay, I'll cheer with everything I've 
got so we won't lose!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's settled, then. The more cheers there 
are, the more exciting it's bound to be—!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: One, two, three♪ One, two, three♪

text_block_list.name: Entourage
text_block_list.text: King♪ King♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
O-ho-ho-ho-ho! Now I'm really getting into 
the groove—!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'll show you first-rate dancing!

text_block_list.name: Entourage
text_block_list.text: Yay☆ King, you're the absolute best~!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Come on, you two join in too and hype this 
up even more!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I grant you the privilege of dancing by 
King's side! Now, come at me—!!

text_block_list.name: Entourage
text_block_list.text: Yeeees♪

Before we knew it, the dance lesson had 
turned into a full-on dance party, but it 
seemed to serve as good practice all the 
same.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Fufu, now that's the spirit.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Then try hyping King's dance to the 
absolute limit—!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: One, two, three♪ One, two, three♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: And here comes the call!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Project your voice from your stomach 
more! And keep it in rhythm—"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —Yeah, looking good!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm picking up the tempo from here on, so 
make sure you keep up!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
O-ho-ho-ho! Be intoxicated by my 
first-rate dance—!!

King Halo's dancing was truly sharp and 
full of groove.
